rules.why: Rows affected reported by the database driver (sqlite `changes` / pg `rowCount`): absent means nothing was written.
Counter / accumulator initialiser: the first occurrence of a key starts at 0 before +1 / +n. Nothing unknown is involved.
Sort comparator / ranking key only — never displayed as a figure.
Next version / reference / ordinal number (max + 1): an identifier, not a measure.
Request / layout / policy parameter defaulting (offset, limit, horizon, cooldown, grace, tolerance, coordinates): not a measured value.
SQL null-key or boolean normalisation (COALESCE(flag,0)=1, COALESCE(site_id,0)=? to match a NULL site, COALESCE(MAX(id),0) for an empty table) — no figure is produced.
Date / time component parsing (missing seconds = 0, cache timestamp absent = never) — not a KPI.
Activity-tracker engine input cell: an empty month cell IS an entry of 0 in the engine contract (byte-identical twin of engine.js).

Count of rows read from a COUNT/SUM (zero rows = a measured zero, the SQL SUM of no row being NULL). The enclosing block is null / absent when the source is not measured (the gate is upstream), so this 0 is never "unknown".
